tasks.title: HANGS Construction · FY2026 Form 1065
tasks.description: Prepare HANGS Construction workpapers from 12 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents and reconcile 2,125 ledger rows. Produce formula-linked Excel evidence and supported figures on an incomplete draft Form 1065. Review every figure and its source. Missing facts, supplementary forms and approvals remain open. This demo plays back one recorded run in about a minute and a half; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with evidence tabs, and an incomplete draft Form 1065 PDF with clickable evidence trails and original source attachments
tasks.gates: Incomplete draft, not reviewed, signed or filed. Missing evidence and differences stay open. A person reviews and signs.
